author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Tagah Reveal Teaser Trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, a 2D anime action fighting game based on the hit Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra series, developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. Players can get a tease at the next upcoming fighter with Tagah joining the fight. Tagah is coming soon to Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam), with a release on Xbox Series X|S on September 3rd. The game is coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 at a later date.
title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game - Official Tagah Reveal Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Bucky ‘Captain America: The Winter Soldier’ Costume Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit free-to-play team-based hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can access the iconic skin from the hit Captain America: The Winter Soldier to keep laying down devastation again, again, and again. The Bucky ‘Captain America: The Winter Soldier’ Costume for Marvel Rivals launches on July 30 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Bucky ‘Captain America: The Winter Soldier’ Costume Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Whiplash is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run. Watch the Whiplash announcement teaser trailer for a peek at what you can expect. Whiplash will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Whiplash - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at Panzer Deck in this announcement trailer for this upcoming game that is a blend of cards, wargaming, and geometric puzzles. In Panzer Deck, cards are more than just stats; they are geometric patterns that allow you to manage resources, recruit units, and amplify their power. Every piece on the map has its key place, and success depends as much on your tactical sense as on your ability to spot patterns. Expand your deck after every encounter to precisely select the ideal set of tools for the upcoming challenge.
title: Panzer Deck - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Clean Those Carpets!: Carpet Cleaning Simulator announcement trailer for this upcoming sim game. Ever seen a video of someone cleaning a really filthy carpet? Clean Those Carpets!: Carpet Cleaning Simulator is exactly that, featuring the satisfying process of cleaning a carpet from filthy to perfectly spotless. Clean Those Carpets!: Carpet Cleaning Simulator will be available on PC in 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Clean Those Carpets!: Carpet Cleaning Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: MineGeon: Renegades is available now on Steam. Watch the MineGeon: Renegades launch traielr for this co-op sci-fi roguelite bullet-hell focused on resource gathering. Descend into the dangerous depths of PAIMO in MineGeon: Renegades. Play solo or with friends as you fight, gather resources, and upgrade together. The deeper you go, the greater the risks, rewards, and secrets waiting beneath the surface.
title: MineGeon: Renegades - Official Launch Trailer

description: Check out the Spider-Man: Brand New Day Costume Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players will take to the battlefield as a new day arrives with the new Spider-Man suit based on his latest MCU appearance in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. The Spider-Man: Brand New Day Costume launches into Marvel Rivals on July 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Spider-Man: Brand New Day Costume Trailer

description: Here's a look at the Playtest Gameplay Trailer for Flick, a psychological first-person horror game developed by Inqdrop Studios. Players will traverse between realities with the flick of a light switch to make sense of a demented family's past. Endure what lies ahead in Flick, coming soon to PC (Steam) with a Playtest coming soon to Steam.
title: Flick - Official Playtest Gameplay Trailer

description: Take a look at the 'Welcome to the West Coast' Trailer for Crazy Taxi: World Tour, the upcoming return of the classic arcade racing game developed by SEGA. Players can take a look at the new West Coast region, where they will drive across sandy beaches, scenic views, and more, all from the comfort of a taxi. Crazy Taxi: World Tour is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam), with a Closed Network Test launching on September 11.
title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour - Official 'Welcome to the West Coast' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Broke Wizards announcement trailer for this upcoming co-op game from 5TH Cell (developer of Scribblenauts). Broke Wizards is a new 1-6 player co-op game where you and your Wizard roommates slay monsters, go racing, play prop hunt or do other crazy jobs to pay rent to a giant Imp Landlord before he eats you. Broke Wizards will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Broke Wizards - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Watch the latest trailer for The Immortal John Triptych, an upcoming collection combining all 3 of Joe Richardson's jaunts into the life of The Immortal John, along with extras, quality-of-life improvements, console releases, support for multiple languages, and more. The Immortal John Triptych is a three-game trifecta of Renaissance adventures in life, love, sin, redemption, and…more sin. The Immortal John Triptych will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC (GOG, Steam, and Epic Games Store) on August 27, 2026.
title: The Immortal John Triptych - Official Release Date Trailer

description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Shards of Order, a card-based RPG developed by Fardust. Players will take the lead in tandem with a party to stack powerful cards, utilize distinct playstyles, and progress through skill trees along the way. Shards of Order is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Shards of Order - Official Launch Trailer

description:

#DeadByDaylight #SummerScreamsEvent #Gaming
title: Dead by Daylight - Official Summer Screams Event 2026 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Apex Legends Marked gameplay trailer to see what to expect with the new season, which features the ability to harness new powers to launch a stealth attack. The Marked season brings a Bloodbound rework, World's Edge map update, Corrupted Attachments, looting changes, Loba & Rampart Legend updates, and more. The Apex Legends: Marked season begins August 4, 2026.

Bloodhound claims the Allfather's blessing, becoming the hunter of Legends: stalking their prey with improved tracking and striking from the shadows with a new Ultimate. Claim new territory in the updated World's Edge, sharpen your arsenal with Corrupted Attachments, and tap into new power with Loba and Rampart buffs. 

Be the predator, or become prey.

#ApexLegends #Gaming #IGN
title: Apex Legends: Marked - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: A new chapter in Port Wake's story awaits. Watch the latest Docked trailer for this simulation game to see what to expect with the second expansion, Contraband. The Contraband DLC features a new campaign mission as you protect the port from illegal cargo. Master the new Forklift, inspect container shipments with the scanner tool, and put your skills to the test across 12 brand-new jobs. The Contraband DLC for Docked is available now on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Docked - Official Contraband DLC Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a sneak peek at the Scottish Highlands Reserve in this latest Planet Zoo 2 trailer for the upcoming strategy simulation game. The new trailer showcases the beauty of the Scottish Highlands wildlife reserve, with mountain landscapes and natural waterways. This habitat is home to red deer and golden eagles. Planet Zoo 2 will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (S5) on October 13, 2026.
title: Planet Zoo 2 - Official Wildlife Reserves Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Stealth, diplomacy, or violence: Which course will you chart, Captain Flynn? Take a look at gameplay from Expeditions: Samurai in this latest trailer for the upcoming strategy RPG. Expeditions: Samurai will be available in Steam Early Access on August 7, 2026.

Are you ready to set sail for feudal Japan? You'll be thrown into the chaos of a civil war reaching its climax, as the Sengoku period draws to a close. After more than 100 years of conflict, brutal battles, and devastating consequences for the civilian population, one final clash remains - and it will determine the fate of your crew, and of all of Japan.
title: Expeditions: Samurai - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Forbidden Brew announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming first-person shop-management game set in a dystopian future where magic has been outlawed by a totalitarian government. Forbidden Brew will be available on PC.

You run an underground shop selling forbidden potions while trying to survive government inspections, surveillance, and raids. Oppressed customers from different backgrounds return with their own stories and problems, but anyone who enters the shop could also be an informant working for the authorities.
title: Forbidden Brew - Official Teaser Trailer

Players can play out the thrills, defeats, and victories of the game of basketball with unprecedented fidelity, new gameplay mechanics, and series-first features to ring in the new era of NBA 2K. NBA 2K27 is launching on September 4 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

title: Crown of Bones - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Slain 2: The Beast Within, a 2D gothic hack-and-slash action platformer developed by Steel Mantis. Embrace the werewolf fury in Slain 2: The Beast Within, coming soon to PlayStation, Xbox, and PC (Steam).
title: Slain 2: The Beast Within - Official Gameplay Trailer

description:
Get an update on the success of the last mission, as the Death Laser project has been eliminated. But it's not over yet! Watch the latest Helldivers 2 trailer for the third-person action-adventure shooter game to learn about your new mission to return focus to the Terminid front. The next mission: reinforce quarantine efforts, contain the spread of the insect menace, and make the galaxy safer for all freedom-loving citizens.
